accessId.description: The access ID of the LMv1 API token.

account.description: The first part of your portal address. For https://acme.logicmonitor.com, enter acme.

authType.description: Choose an authentication method to access LogicMonitor.

cacheMaxEntries.description: Number of metadata responses kept in the cache.

cacheTTLSeconds.description: How long metric names, labels and label values are cached in seconds.

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Route requests to this data source through Grafana's Secure Socks Proxy (Private Data Source Connect).

lmTimeout.description: Time allowed for each LogicMonitor API call in seconds, including all chunks of a long time range.

maxConcurrentRequests.description: API requests this data source can have in flight at once.

maxRateLimitWaitSeconds.description: Longest wait in seconds for the rate-limit window to reset.

maxRetryAttempts.description: Includes the first attempt. Retries on rate limiting, 502, 503, 504 and network errors.

queryRangeWorkers.description: Long time ranges are split into 25-day chunks. Number of chunks fetched in parallel per query.

secureValues.description: The bearer token shown when the API token was created.
The access key of the LMv1 API token.

examples.description: Connect to LogicMonitor using a bearer API token.

lmv1.description: Connect to LogicMonitor using an LMv1 access ID and access key.
